Aisle50 came out of the summer 2011 class at Y Combinator, the Silicon Valley accelerator.  Aisle50 builds CPG and retailer campaigns aimed to get both banner and brand incremental shoppers, bigger share and valuable brand messaging to consumers.

Our product has a two-year track record of producing baskets that are 30% larger for our retailers.  We also give our retailer partners incremental trips that, in the past, they would have lost to competitors.  Aisle50 content, because much of it is in the form of offers that are paid for through Web or Mobile, compel the consumer to head to the store sooner rather than later.  

Everybody wins: We drive trips to stores, new customers to CPGs and big discounts to consumers.

launches.title: Locale: Unlock 50% more daily energy ⚡️ by optimizing what you eat
launches.tagline: Locale delivers meals made with natural ingredients and optimized nutrient ratios — all designed to improve your energy and productivity (California only).
launches.body:
**TLDR:** After noticing how much my diet impacted my productivity, I spent six months researching and A/B testing different diets to find one that gave me the most energy and mental clarity. Eventually, I found a protocol that worked — not just for me, but for dozens of my closest friends. But I couldn't find the time to cook consistently and no meal service met my standards. So I built my own.

### **Problem ❌**

As a founder, I never had time to cook, so I’d always settle for Doordash meals that made me feel sluggish and low energy. After doing some research, I realized that most prepared meals have:

* **Low quality and processed ingredients** - produce sprayed with synthetic pesticides and sauces filled with processed ingredients and artificial emulsifiers (neurotoxins that can harm brain function over time)
* **Unhealthy oils** - full of low-quality vegetable and seed oils, which throw off your Omega 6 to Omega 3 ratio (key to optimal cellular and brain function)
* **Little to no fiber and protein** – dietary fiber and lean muscle mass are both huge components to regulating blood sugar (critical to sustaining energy levels)
* **Packaging full of microplastics -** heating food in plastic containers leeches toxic chemicals and disrupts hormones

After realizing that the way I eat can have a huge effect on my productivity levels, I started trying out “healthy” meal delivery services. Most tasted bad and claimed to be healthy, but after digging deeper, I realized it was mostly BS marketing with no real nutrition standards to back them up.

The Blueprint service appeared to be the best option, but after doing more research, I found that they just outsourced their food production to a company that uses seed oils and low-quality ingredients.

Every service I tried was compromised in some way. **I couldn’t find any options that hit all of the science-based health standards that I cared about and helped me perform my best.**

---

### **Solution 💡**

I spent a long time doing research (and crunching studies with chatGPT) to come up with a strict list of rules for the food that I wanted to eat. Then, I found an experienced chef with over 20 years of fine dining experience and gave him a carefully curated list of approved ingredients for each meal.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88937&key=user_uploads/714052/e2221663-6c7b-4412-91ff-e4f7240f6c40)

The meals that he created were delicious, and after a few weeks, I started noticing I felt different. **I had more energy throughout the day, felt much less fatigue after a long day of work, and started sleeping better.**

My friends asked to join in and get meals from my chef, and many began to notice the same benefits that I did. That’s when I decided to offer this as a service to everyone.

### **Our Ask ❤️**

We want Locale to be the best delivery service for people who care about their mental performance and long-term health.

* **Have you found any nutritional hacks that have helped you be more productive?** Tell us what worked (or didn't). Feel free to email me at [chris@shoplocale.com](mailto:chris@shoplocale.com).
* **Want to try Locale and live in the SF Bay Area or LA?** Check it out [here](https://shoplocale.com/?auto-code=YCLAUNCH2FREEMEALS). We’ll include 2 free meals on your first order.

launches.title: Locale: Office lunches designed for startups
launches.tagline: We partner with local restaurants to offer heat-and-eat meals that last the whole week in your fridge
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

**It’s time-consuming and expensive to coordinate food delivery every day for office lunches** so we partnered with local restaurants to offer heat-and-eat meals that last the whole week in your office fridge. Your employees place one group order the prior week and all meals arrive Monday morning. No need to coordinate daily orders and deliveries. Employees can grab meals from the fridge and microwave for 1 min whenever they’re hungry.

### **Who we are**

👋🏻 Hi everyone! We’re Chris and Jonny with Locale. We both grew up in the Bay Area and love good food & supporting local restaurants!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73795&key=user_uploads/714052/de350a63-3fbb-475f-a8d5-0732dd859bcb)

_Chris (left) and Jonny (right)._

### **😡 The problem**

When we started working in person this year we tried dozens of lunch services and couldn't find a good option for startups with <20 employees

* It’s a pain to coordinate daily orders and daily deliveries for employee lunches
* Food delivery is expensive and it’s hard to find one restaurant that everyone likes
* Most small startups are below the order minimum for catering services

### **😋 Our solution**

Locale partners with top local restaurants to offer heat-and-eat meals that last all week in your office fridge. Your employees place one group order by Friday for all their lunches for the following week and they arrive Monday morning. Employees can grab them and quickly reheat whenever they’re hungry.

### **⚙️ How does it work?**

1. Employees choose from 100+ prepared meals from 20+ top restaurants. All meals are $11 or less.
2. Since orders are pre-scheduled, we're able to place bulk orders days ahead of pickup with restaurants, saving them time and money. We then pass along savings to you.
3. Meals from multiple restaurants are **delivered together** and arrive refrigerated. Meals are sealed to extend their shelf life. All meals are ready in 2 steps or less.

### **🙏🏻 Ask/Give**

We’re offering a **week of free lunches** to Bay Area-based YC startups to get your feedback and improve the service.

If you’re interested, take 1 min to fill out [**this form**](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSckO2DlHw7nZ7D7CprRgDHYIdutqipfRj8V9tdIa4GXg2h6Uw/viewform) and I’ll reach out ASAP to send you a link that your employees can use to order.

launches.title: 🛒 Vendora - Ecommerce enablement for grocery
launches.tagline: Vendora is a vertical saas platform that enables grocers to earn more revenue and better manage their operations online.
launches.body:
Hey all! I’m Sunny, the founder of [Vendora](https://www.vendora.io/).

**tl;dr** At Vendora, we build vertical saas for the grocery industry - today we focus on e-commerce enablement, helping grocers make the most of their digital channels. Think of us as Shopify Meets Toast for supermarkets.  

### Problem

A monumental $800B grocery industry runs on outdated systems and manual processes. In an age where 12% of grocery sales have gone online, many grocers are getting left behind, lacking the tools to adapt and make the most of this emerging channel. Grocers need to adapt to compete with the Amazon and Walmarts of the world.

### Solution

Vendora is solving this problem by being the one platform grocers need to engage with customers digitally. We make it easy for them to succeed online. 

By connecting with their existing stack, we ingest their data, augment it through our AI powered workflows, and set up accurate, enhanced data feeds to their third parties. We also give them their own storefront (website and app) so they can own more of the customer relationship. Along with all this, we give them the tools to easily manage these channels, optimize their performance, and engage with their customers.  

### Who am I?

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74433&key=user_uploads/1224770/f850f527-6a20-494e-be39-33fa37d566cb)

I’ve quite literally have been in the grocery space for my entire life. 

I grew up in grocery stores, working in my family’s supermarkets, seeing it go from a single 500 sq ft family store in Queens, NY to a chain of stores. I’ve seen it all first hand (stocking, the register, backoffice, you name it). 

Professionally, I was the Head of US Strategy at Uber Grocery coming in through Uber’s acquisition of Cornershop, where I earned my startup stripes. I began my career at Amazon's US Grocery team, worked on ops for Amazon Fresh, and then the Search Science and AI team. I’ve seen how some of the best companies on the planet run things and I’m channeling that expertise into Vendora. 

### Ask

Know any grocers that want to start selling online or earn even more on existing channels? Send them our way. [founders@vendora.io](mailto:founders@vendora.io)

launches.title: Airgoods – the wholesale marketplace for food & beverage
launches.tagline: We connect specialty food stores with their next best selling products
launches.body:
**TLDR:** [**Airgoods**](https://airgoods.com/) is a wholesale marketplace that makes it easy for specialty food stores to buy their inventory in one place. Today, we focus on connecting these stores with over 1,000 non-alcoholic and functional beverage products.

Hi everyone! We’re Aaron, Elian and Paolo – the team behind Airgoods. We’re on a mission to level the playing field for specialty food stores by offering tools previously only available to big box chains.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73226&key=user_uploads/797737/38498184-4bb5-425f-8025-35e02960e710)

### 🤔 **The Problem**

* **Specialty food stores struggle to stay up to date on new and trending products.** Today, most rely on social media platforms like Instagram for discovery. Once they see a product they like, they send the brand a DM to ask for a sample – which can take weeks to months to receive.
* **To purchase inventory, they have to manage dozens of direct brand relationships.** That means placing orders and coordinating payments over email, phone calls and texts.
* **Best sellers often go out of stock.** At most specialty stores, reorders only happens when the buyer sees that the shelf is empty. This means there are days – if not weeks – that go by with best sellers being out of stock.
* **Most brands don’t have the resources to run an in-house wholesale team.** They primarily rely on inbounds, and many relationships end because of limited resources to maintain the account over email, Instagram DMs, and texts.

### **🧰 Our Solution**

Airgoods makes it easy for specialty food stores to discover, sample and order inventory in one place. How?

* **Curated marketplace views that align with store type.** This industry is unique in that the product mix is homogenous within the same store type. For example: an specialty cheese shop in New York offers the same kind of products as one in San Francisco. This allows us to show a business all of the products they want – and nothing they don’t – with high accuracy. For example, today liquor stores and NA bottle shops see the following.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73226&key=user_uploads/797737/653e9c5f-f193-4070-9c93-b6da89fddb52)

* **Simplified sample requests.** On Airgoods, stores receive samples in days instead of weeks. We do this by making it easy for brands to track and fulfill samples with in-platform tools that embed the process into their daily order fulfillment workflows. By streamlining this process, we also help brands boost sample to order conversion rates.
* **Data-driven recommendations and insights.** We provide our buyers with insight into what products are selling best in similar stores around the country. This adds transparency for an industry that traditionally relies on word-of-mouth recommendations.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73226&key=user_uploads/797737/015ce154-6e52-4ac5-b3ce-058e77460b29)

We also integrate with Shopify, which allows brands to fulfill orders from Airgoods without having to onboard to a new sales channel.

### **🐶 Who are we?**

We are three Yale alums who have been close friends since our first year of college. Before starting Airgoods, Aaron and Elian worked together at an emerging VC fund in NYC, and Paolo and Elian were on Yale’s mens soccer team.

Aaron’s dad owns a brick and mortar shop in Maine, and he saw how challenges around ordering inventory put his small store at a major disadvantage to big box chains with dedicated buying teams.

### **🙂 Our Ask**

* Do you have any favorite non-alcoholic or functional beverage brands? Let us know! We’d love to onboard them [**🥂**](https://emojipedia.org/clinking-glasses/)
* Connect us to anyone you may know in the specialty grocery / wholesale space (store owners, brand owners, service providers) – we’d love to chat at [**founders@airgoods.com**](mailto:founders@airgoods.com)

launches.title: 🥑 Guac: Ending grocery food waste with AI
launches.body:
**TLDR:** We tell grocery stores exactly how many avocados they’ll sell next Tuesday.\
\
[Guac](http://tryguac.co) uses machine learning to accurately predict how much grocery retailers will sell each day. This helps them order the perfect amount of inventory: enough to meet customer demand without sending tons of leftover food to landfill.

### **🗑️ PROBLEM**

* **Predicting future demand is hard**: product-level demand drastically fluctuates each day based on hundreds of factors like weather, road closures, and sports games. Yet, even the largest supermarket chains still use basic regression models or Excel formulas, which means … 
* **Tons of food waste and empty shelves**: which costs grocery retailers in Europe/US $188B and costs our planet 15 million metric tons of greenhouse gas emissions each year.

### **🥑 OUR SOLUTION**

* **Industry-leading algorithm** that predicts order quantities for each item, each day, each store location. Our average forecast error (MAE) for our current customers is 0.95 units, which translates to a 38% reduction in food waste.

![](https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/ib8L-X2brvq2yDx0i7QlNLakpS-1x79zlJSzMI5phoohO6II0KB9q3GhWEilhqDc6sXoBUm24rj4NXCX4O5sTa9susviyZFku6vb0YzC9_qIVa0Nbq-6YMHvuNaBx_P8_30I8wteFfbGtJu_3g5vdqo)

* How?
  * **More than just ML**: Grocery demand is driven by real world events that ML models don’t know exist. So we inject 230+ external variables to actually capture people’s buying behavior …  
  * **_For example,_** _we found that sports betting odds help us predict beer sales. When a sports match is predicted to be a close game, it turns out more people watch the game, driving up beer sales!_
  * **Customized** for each store location: grocery stores located just 5 miles apart have different customer behavior.
* **Inventory ordering optimization**: We then turn our hyper-accurate predictions into useful inventory order quantities, based on individual SKU-specific requirements: minimum order quantities, promotions, unknown loss estimates, shelf life, supplier lead times, and more.
* **Modular integration:** We integrate our ordering recommendations right into the retailer’s existing inventory ordering softwares and workflow. Whether inventory ordering is done at the HQ-level vs. store-level, we fit into the retailer’s system, instead of forcing them to uproot their system to fit into ours.

### **🙏 OUR ASK**

We’d love introductions to grocery chains (anywhere in the world), especially:

1. Discount grocery chains, with tighter margins
2. Grocery chains in more remote locations (e.g. Hawaii), with longer supplier lead times and inflexible supply chain
3. Asian grocery chains in the US, who import a lot of their products from abroad

And if you know anyone in the general food/grocery space (POS providers, suppliers/distributors, grocery food waste charities, etc), please let us know at [founders@tryguac.co](mailto:founders@tryguac.co).

* Out of stocks wipe out 4% more in lost sales
* Slip-and-fall hazards lead to liability risks.
* These slim margins prevent grocers from hiring back office staff.
